title: The Overturned Cart
text: A cart lies on its side in a ditch, wheels in the air, its mule long gone. Sacks of grain have split open in the mud. Among them is a locked chest. A smell hangs over it that is not grain, sweet and heavy, and the flies are thick.

options.label: The craftiest picks the chest's lock before whoever owned it comes looking.

outcomes.text: Inside is coin, along with a letter someone in town would pay to see.
A needle hides in the lock, with something on the needle.

options.label: The hardiest goes down into the ditch to learn what the sweet smell is.

outcomes.text: Whatever ate the mule is still in the ditch. It is still hungry.

options.label: Take the grain and go, before the flies find out who you are.

outcomes.text: The sacks the flies have not found give bread for a week.
